summary: Covers manufacturers of passenger vehicles, light trucks and motorcycles. Disclosure topics are product safety, labour practices, fuel economy and use-phase emissions, materials sourcing, and materials efficiency and recycling.

questions.text: What percentage of your vehicle models are rated by NCAP with an overall 5-star safety rating, by region?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage by region, for models rated by a New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) with an overall 5-star rating.

questions.text: How many safety-related defect complaints did your organisation receive, and what percentage were investigated?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the number of safety-related defect complaints and (2) the percentage investigated.

questions.text: How many vehicles did your organisation recall?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of vehicles recalled during the reporting period.

questions.text: What percentage of your active workforce is employed under collective agreements?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage of active employees covered by collective bargaining or collective agreements.

questions.text: How many work stoppages did your organisation experience, and how many total days were idle as a result?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Days idle · Report (1) the number of work stoppages and (2) the total days idle, for the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your sales-weighted average passenger fleet fuel economy, by region?
questions.hint: Unit: Mpg, L/km, gCO2/km, km/L · Report by region, in mpg, L/km, gCO2/km or km/L, weighted by vehicle sales.

questions.text: How many (1) zero emission vehicles (ZEV), (2) hybrid vehicles and (3) plug-in hybrid vehicles did you sell?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number sold for each of ZEV, hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles separately.

questions.text: What is your strategy for managing fleet fuel economy and emissions risks and opportunities?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your strategy, including regulatory and market risks, product plans, and how you manage opportunities in fuel economy and emissions.

questions.text: How does your organisation manage the risks associated with the use of critical materials?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how risks from critical materials (supply, price, availability, regulation) are identified and managed, including mitigation strategies such as substitution, recycling or supplier engagement.

questions.text: What is (1) the total amount of waste from manufacturing and (2) the percentage recycled?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total manufacturing waste in metric tonnes and (2) the percentage recycled.

parts.label: Total amount of waste from manufacturing

questions.text: What is (1) the weight of end-of-life material your organisation recovered and (2) the percentage recycled?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) the weight of end-of-life material recovered in metric tonnes and (2) the percentage recycled.

questions.text: What is the average recyclability of the vehicles you sold?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by sales-weighted metric tonnes (t) · Report the average recyclability as a percentage, weighted by sales in metric tonnes, and state the calculation method used.

questions.text: How many vehicles did your organisation manufacture?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of vehicles manufactured in the reporting period.

questions.text: How many vehicles did your organisation sell?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of vehicles sold in the reporting period.
